notes: Zero-Energy Charger Recovery: fixes an impossible deadlock where an idle citizen could reach 0% energy while still inside a location that contains an operational charger but remain more than 5 m from the charger’s local coordinate. Agent City now performs a narrow diagnostic/admin recovery on startup and world ticks: it aligns only that stranded citizen to the nearest operational charger at the same location, grants no energy, creates no fictional citizen action, records the intervention as diagnostic recovery, and makes the citizen planner-eligible so the existing critical-energy rule can resume ordinary charging. Citizens at other locations are never teleported to a charger.
